name: Gaining Corruption
summary: ● Catastrophic Perils or direct possession pressure. ● Bargaining with a Warp entity. ● Using a forbidden relic whose rules state that it corrupts the bearer. ● Deliberately channelling unstable or Malefic power beyond safe limits. ● Prolonged exposure to a major daemonic ritual or Warp breach. ● Failing a clearly announced corruption save at a major narrative threshold.
